candidate_program.name: local_density_discount
candidate_program.rationale: Discounts aggregate rival pressure when active neighbors conflict among themselves, while retaining the strongest rival as a floor. Local induced-edge computation can be quadratic in active degree.
candidate_program.rule: weight / (1 + max(max_conflict_weight, conflict_weight / (1 + 2 * neighbor_edges / max(1, degree))) / (1 + weight))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
